Protocol O - Ophthalmology / Otorhinolaryngology (nasal)

Protocol cds protocol gut digestive

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Gastrointestinal support protocol using CDS for digestive conditions and gut healing.

Indications

  • Ophthalmology/ENT
  • Eye ear nose throat

Steps

  1. Prepare gut support dose
  2. Follow digestive protocol
  3. Monitor digestive symptoms

Gut support protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

Monitoring

  • Track healing
